walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE English Language specification.

Unit 3: Studying Spoken and Written Language appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Unit 3: Studying Spoken and Written Language in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Unit 3: Studying Spoken and Written Language.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
